The '''Persuader heavy stun gun''' was a model of [[Stun gun/Legends|stun gun]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. The [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|Seeker]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Lux]] was fitted with a retractable Persuader heavy stun gun.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
